'''VibroSword Two''' was the callsign of the second member of [[VibroSword Squadron]], which flew for the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]]. During said battle, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified pilot (VibroSword Two)|pilot]] flew under the sign and served as the [[VibroSword Leader|squadron leader's]] wingwoman.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
